name: immunoglobulin kappa locus

function.text: IGK is the immunoglobulin kappa light-chain locus and contributes to antibody diversity through variable-to-joining segment rearrangement in B cells.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Burkitt lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports rearrangement context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
